summary: Sandisk Corporation filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, reporting that on September 9, 2026 it entered into Amendment No. 1 to its February 21, 2025 Loan Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent. The amendment refinances existing revolving commitments with a new $1,500.0 million revolving credit facility maturing September 9, 2031, priced at Adjusted Term SOFR or daily simple SOFR plus 1.375% (or base rate plus 0.375%), with a 0.175% commitment fee, both subject to net-leverage or ratings-based step-ups and step-downs, guaranteed by Sandisk Technologies, Inc. No special-situation transaction is present.
